tests/e2e/camera.py.name: Camera tests
tests/e2e/camera.py.description: Copies sides from the family's real photos, a synthetic 3x3 side and a fake live camera, and checks the colors read right.

tests/e2e/fixtures.js.name: Test fixtures
tests/e2e/fixtures.js.description: Makes what the browser tests need: a random 3x3 scramble, a synthetic 3x3 side photo, and a fake camera clip from a real photo.

tests/e2e/flows.py.name: Solve flow tests
tests/e2e/flows.py.description: Solves the known 2x2 in every language and a 3x3 in a phone-sized browser, checking the switch, the theme toggle, the credits line, the phone's language, reloads, Start over and blocked storage.

tests/e2e/screens.py.name: Screen walk
tests/e2e/screens.py.description: Walks 22 screens in one language, comparing English text with its snapshot, checking no foreign words remain and the credits line is there, and measuring heights.

tests/e2e/screenshots.py.name: README screenshots
tests/e2e/screenshots.py.description: Takes the three phone screenshots the README shows: the welcome screen, copying a 3x3 side, and a turn in dark mode.
